Subject: Regional Hosting Runbook Workshop — scheduling and constraints

Hi Anika / Darren —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused runbook workshop to align on multi-region hosting decisions (EU data locality, US backups, APAC cutover windows), failover behavior, and a short ops handoff checklist. Goal is: come away with a one-page runbook and an internal schedule for the pilot.

Proposed 45-minute slot options (all times shown with local equivalents):
- Option A: Oct 6, 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / Oct 7 01:00 SGT
- Option B: Oct 9, 16:00 PT / Oct 10 00:00 CET / Oct 10 08:00 SGT
- Option C: Oct 11, 11:00 PT / 19:00 CET / Oct 12 03:00 SGT

Quick asks before we lock time:
1) Can you confirm whether FinTechCo legal or security will join (we expect 20 minutes for data residency questions)? If not, we'll record those Qs and share answers.
2) Any blackout windows for APAC (team offsites, holidays) in the first half of Oct?
3) Who should receive the final runbook (ops pager, SOC contact, and your infra lead)?

I've attached a short proposed agenda and an initial runbook draft we can iterate on during the call. If none of the slots work, feel free to pick a 30/45m slot on my Calendly link below and Marcus/Vivek will join the technical portion.

Attachments: proposed-agenda.pdf (1 page), regional-runbook-draft.md (draft)
Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/runbook-workshop-30m

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the clear options. A couple of notes from our side:
- Our EU infra lead (Darren) will absolutely join — he can handle the technical residency questions.
- Our APAC team has an offsite on Oct 6–7 and will not be available overnight those days, so Option A is tricky because it falls during their travel.
- Legal (contract counsel) cannot join live this week but can be on a follow-up 30-minute slot next week; they asked that we capture the residency Qs in writing beforehand.

Of the three options, Option B (Oct 9) is the least bad for us if we end at 45 minutes sharp; Option C would be OK if we can split the session (30m technical / 15m legal follow-up asynchronously).

I can confirm attendees: Anika Rao (PO), Darren Liu (infra lead). I'll defer to Darren on whether to invite our security contact; happy to add them if you think it's necessary.
